name: Exit code decoder
author: friday-core
description: Looks up exit codes and HRESULTs: winget (0x8A150014 no packages found, 0x8A15002B no applicable update), MSI (1603 fatal error, 3010 restart required, 1618 another install running), common Win32 and NTSTATUS codes, curl, git, Node and signals, and robocopy bit flags. Signed numbers are converted to hex. Only documented codes are listed: an unknown number is reported as unknown, never guessed.
